en.title: Paytm shares drop 3% after govt shields UPI payments only up to Rs 2,000 from charges. Should you buy the dip?

stories.title: HDFC Bank share price target: What are Jefferies, 3 other foreign brokerages saying as CEO hunt intensifies?

en.title: HDFC Bank share price target: What are Jefferies, 3 other foreign brokerages saying as CEO hunt intensifies?
en.summary: HDFC Bank submitted two CEO candidates to regulators as the bank proceeds with leadership succession. Foreign brokerages including Jefferies, Nomura, Bernstein and Macquarie maintain positive outlooks with price targets between Rs 880 and Rs 1,150, viewing management clarity as a potential catalyst for stock re-rating.

stories.title: Rs 1.13 lakh crore boom in one corner, a bust in another: What changed in the AI trade?

en.title: Rs 1.13 lakh crore boom in one corner, a bust in another: What changed in the AI trade?
en.summary: Indian IT stocks rose 5%, adding Rs 1.13 lakh crore in market value, as easing concerns over frontier AI disruption boosted the sector. Power and infrastructure stocks tied to AI development declined sharply, reflecting a shift in investor positioning between traditional software services and AI infrastructure.
